name: cove-mcp
description: The first CLI and MCP server for Cove Data Protection — fleet-wide backup health, billing usage, and storage trends from a terminal, with the local history the vendor console doesn't keep.

cove_partner.title: Cove customer/partner
cove_partner.description: The full customer/partner string exactly as it appears in the Cove console dropdown, including the parenthesised email, e.g. 'Acme Corp (admin@acme.com)'. API users require it, and a wrong format returns the same error as a bad password.

cove_password.title: Cove API token
cove_password.description: API token issued with the Cove API user. Cove shows it once, at creation.

cove_username.title: Cove API user login
cove_username.description: Login name of the Cove API user (Cove console: Settings > API users). This is the API user's login, not your console email.

cove_base_url.title: Cove Data Protection API base URL
cove_base_url.description: Base URL for the Cove Data Protection API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.
